answer.title: OUEST1-INV02 PV Inverter and DC Field Failure Modes and Incidents
answer.synopsis: The PV inverter and the upstream DC field at OUEST1-INV02 have experienced several incidents, with a total moderate and severe incident cost of over 228,167 EUR. The most costly failure mode involves superficial damages to PV modules, while wiring degradation and short-circuits also contribute significantly. Given the high risk level and the criticality score within the site, initial actions should focus on thermography inspections, wiring tests, and regular cleaning to mitigate further damage and reduce costs.
